headline: DPR and Economists Praise BI's Move to Raise BI Rate to Maintain Rupiah
summary: Bank Indonesia raised its BI-Rate to 6.00 percent to stabilise the rupiah and control inflation. Lawmakers and economists have backed the move, which affects borrowing by households.
why: Bank Indonesia sets the benchmark policy rate, and its decisions influence Indonesian bond yields, bank lending rates and the rupiah.
why_moved: The decision was taken to stabilise the rupiah and control inflation, according to the report. Higher policy rates typically raise bond yields and can reduce appetite for equities.
original_headline: DPR dan Ekonom Puji Langkah BI Naikkan BI Rate untuk Jaga Rupiah
